title: Where the Arm Can Work: Reach by Sampling, the Shorter Reach With the Tool Down, the Smaller Region Where It Can Move Well, and What Fits on a Table

artifact.note: the workspace of an arm in three dimensions: random joint angles through forward kinematics marked into a grid of voxels (optionally only those poses whose smallest singular value is above a floor, the dexterous ones), the volume read off the grid, the farthest reach found, and what the tool can reach pointing straight down, by the closed form of lesson 28-04 inside the joint limits: the farthest out along an axis and the share of a table
